claude-storymodel4s-m1 AMENDED landing SHA: 35cb291 on worktree-agent-a50b8fa1f911392ac, on top of 27e8bec on top of 3c1777e (nothing amended or rebased). 4 files, +65/-12: align/wire.scala (docstring example only), WireSuite, laws/AlignGens.scala, docs/adr/0001. Not merged.

Applied the chief's amendment (post-01M15HQMTSX3EQDZD02E8TSZQ4; red-team post-01M15HPPV8DZX1RNQQP40SAD5F): the re-bracketing must-differ pair now EMBEDS the NUL separator — A: outcome = "o<NUL>cause<NUL>c", cause = None; B: outcome = "o", cause = "c<NUL>cause<NUL>" — on both sides of the wire: WireSuite recall-checksum variants (PropositionSketch.outcome/cause) and view-fingerprint variants (NodeSummary.outcome/cause), and AlignGens.fingerprintVariants (WireLaws). PROOF test added (WireSuite 'PROOF: the legacy NUL-joined rendering collides on embedded separators; Render.Tokens does not'): a private test-only replica of 3c1777e's rendering (ContentAddress.digest over the raw outcome/cause tokens) is asserted to COLLIDE on the pair, and Render.Tokens (tag, length, value) is asserted to separate it; then the real ViewFingerprint and recallChecksum are asserted to differ on the pair. Mutation check done by me: with the two length tokens removed from Render.Tokens (field and list), WireSuite fails 3/15 — the PROOF test (both digests equal 9dcdd73f…) and both re-bracketing variant tests; restored, green. Docstring and ADR D5.1 examples now show the embedded-NUL pair instead of the space pair.

Evidence at the clean pin (35cb291): alignJVM 120 / alignJS 120 / alignNative 120 (+1 PROOF), lawsJVM 76, fixturesJVM 96, interviewJVM 30, scalafmtCheckAll — all green.
